# AltTabio

> AltTabio is a free, open-source Alt+Tab replacement and window switcher for 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11. It shows a numbered list of open windows, a live preview of the selected window, and filters the list as you type. No ads, no account, no telemetry, no network access.

AltTabio is an independent project. It is not affiliated with Alt+Tab Terminator or Microsoft.
